words: [CONFIRM] What LTV means here and how it is measured (the ladder reads LTV 2,000 = RM 28, so it is an RM value).
The 70 players picked every Monday by Retention Team Admin. Tier 3 and Tier V only. Worked 10 a day, Monday to Sunday.
[CONFIRM] What FTV is, and what "LTV of 7 or more" means in the Monday selection.
The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
Valid: no LTV reward this week, no Daily P&L reward this week, and the SW covers the bonus (SW x 40%). Invalid: IM + Push only, no SMS, no bonus mention.

The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this player ready for an LTV bonus?
items: The player is in today's batch of 10 (today's day, not another day's)
No LTV reward and no Daily P&L reward this week
SW refreshed today, and the ladder bonus fits SW x 40%
tour.done: All three: engage the player first, then issue.
tour.notYet: Any "no": IM + Push only, no SMS and no bonus mention.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Seven steps, in this order
items: Find today's 10
Team Engagement File, Handover Tab, today's exact day. Exactly 10.
Paste and dedupe
Paste values into Lark Base, LTV (Day). Remove anyone who got Daily P&L or this week's LTV. Under 10 left: fill down the ranking.
Pre-check
Not given this week, currently active, SW enough (bonus at or below SW x 40%).
Engage first
Open with a greeting and watch the reply. Active: go on. Cold: you can delay.
Send
Valid: username list to Admin for SMS, you send IM + Push. Invalid: IM + Push only.
Issue and ticket
Lark ticket, query VVIP LTV 70 BONUS, with username, amount and screenshot. Tick Claimed.
Tag and QA
Tag Weekly LTV Rewarded (Week XX). QA Record with a BO screenshot.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Go over 10 players in a day, or carry players over to tomorrow.
Borrow another day's batch, even when today's list is empty. Report it to the ATL.
Issue above SW x 40%, or size on a SW that was not refreshed today.
Issue before the player has engaged.

tour.label: Which batch
tour.title: Is today's list empty?
tour.yes: Report it to the ATL. Do not borrow another day's batch.
tour.no: Work today's 10 only: Monday 1 to 10, Tuesday 11 to 20, and so on to Sunday 61 to 70.

pool.q: It is Tuesday. Which players do you work?
pool.why: One batch per day: Monday 1 to 10, Tuesday 11 to 20, through to Sunday 61 to 70.

pool.q: Today's batch is empty. What do you do?
pool.why: Never borrow another day's batch. An empty list is reported to the ATL.

pool.q: You finished 10 players and one more looks promising. Can you do an 11th?
pool.why: The daily quota is exactly 10. Never exceed it and never carry over.

pool.q: A player in today's batch got a Daily P&L reward this week. What now?
o: Remove them and fill down the ranking
pool.why: Dedupe: remove anyone who got Daily P&L or this week's LTV, then fill down the ranking.

pool.q: LTV RM 10,000 (ladder RM 118). SW RM 250, so SW x 40% = RM 100. What do you issue?
pool.why: Never above SW x 40%. The highest ladder row at or below RM 100 is RM 98.

pool.q: The player is valid but has not replied to your greeting. Do you issue the bonus?
o: No, the player must engage first; you can delay
pool.why: Engage before issuance. Active: go on. Cold: you can delay.

pool.q: An invalid player is in today's batch. What do they get?
o: SMS + IM + Push with the offer
IM + Push only, no bonus mention
pool.why: Invalid players get IM + Push only. No SMS, no bonus mention. SMS is sent by Admin for valid players only.

pool.q: You issued the LTV bonus. What do you tag?
pool.why: Tag Weekly LTV Rewarded with the correct week number, then update the QA Record.
